precondition: Start after fixed/K1 cohort succeeds; preserve and resolve any prior failure first.
calibration: Same seed: ASan+UBSan oracle-corruption red, short sanitized system/K32 pilot and short native system/K32 pilot before long cohort.
added_coverage: Sustained default libc allocation/reuse/retention and K32 servicing, distinct from fixed buddy/K1. Semantic operation families intentionally overlap.
limits: Exact managed object/requested recovery and tracked system allocation recovery must be zero; OS RSS may retain allocator arenas and need not return to zero. Native RSS ceiling unchanged. No throughput/latency inference while concurrent workloads run. No additional lazy cohort without a new VM-pressure premise.
driver_change_planned: Persist absolute monotonic origin and allow explicit long profile/seed in a new immutable runner snapshot after the current fixed cohort ends; current running source files remain unchanged.
threshold_sampling_scope: Requested/charged values checked after completed epochs, as in the first cohort; not continuous within-epoch caps. Exact full recovery checked separately. RSS is periodic ps sampling.
clarification: Initial cap terminology was overbroad; this adds measurement-scope clarification without raising any threshold or changing the main workload.
